name: drizzle-e2e-cloudflare
description: Baked dependency set for the Cloudflare drizzle-e2e lanes (d1 and durable). The packages UNDER TEST (@mionjs/drizzle-orm*, @ts-runtypes/bin) are NOT here: each run installs them from the in-container verdaccio. miniflare brings its own workerd, so this lane needs no database server and no docker.
